import sys
import heapq

N = 50
M = 50
K = 50
T = N + K + 1
N_ = N * T + 1
M_ = K + (M * 2 * K + N) * (T - 1)
INF = 0x3f3f3f3f

class L:
    def __init__(self, j):
        self.next = None
        self.j = j

class Edge:
    def __init__(self, u, v, cap, cost):
        self.u = u
        self.v = v
        self.cap = cap
        self.cost = cost

def lt(u, v):
    return pi[u] < pi[v] or (pi[u] == pi[v] and kk[u] < kk[v])

def i2(i):
    return (i *= 2) > cnt and 0 or i < cnt and lt(pq[i + 1], pq[i]) and i + 1 or i

def pq_up(u):
    i = iq[u]
    while i and lt(u, pq[i // 2]):
        j = i // 2
        pq[iq[pq[j]] = i] = pq[j]
        i = j
    pq[iq[u] = i] = u

def pq_dn(u):
    i = iq[u]
    while i:
        j = i2(i)
        if lt(pq[j], u):
            pq[iq[pq[j]] = i] = pq[j]
            i = j
        else:
            break
    pq[iq[u] = i] = u

def pq_add(u):
    iq[u] = cnt + 1
    pq_up(u)

def pq_remove_first():
    u = pq[1]
    v = pq[cnt]
    iq[v] = 1
    pq_dn(v)
    return u

def add(i, j):
    l = aa[i].next
    aa[i].next = L(j)
    aa[i].next.next = l

def add_(i, h):
    l = aa_[i].next
    aa_[i].next = L(h)
    aa_[i].next.next = l

def link(u, v, cap, cost):
    h = m_ + 1
    uu[h] = u
    vv[h] = v
    uv[h] = u ^ v
    cost_[h] = cost
    cc[h << 1 ^ 0] = cap
    add_(u, h << 1 ^ 0)
    add_(v, h << 1 ^ 1)

def dijkstra(s):
    global pi, kk, bb
    pi = [INF] * n_
    pi[s] = 0
    pq_add(s)
    while cnt:
        u = pq_remove_first()
        for l in aa_[u].next:
            h = l.j
            if cc[h]:
                h_ = h >> 1
                p = pi[u] + (h & 1 and -cost_[h] or cost_[h])
                v = u ^ uv[h]
                if pi[v] == INF:
                    pi[v] = p
                    kk[v] = kk[u] + 1
                    bb[v] = h_
                    pq_add(v)
                elif pi[v] > p or (pi[v] == p and kk[v] > kk[u] + 1):
                    pi[v] = p
                    kk[v] = kk[u] + 1
                    bb[v] = h_
                    pq_up(v)
    return

def push(s, t):
    global cc
    u = t
    while u != s:
        h = bb[u] >> 1
        cc[h] -= 1
        cc[h ^ 1] += 1
        u ^= uv[h]

def edmonds_karp(s, t):
    global cost_
    cost_ = cost.copy()
    while 1:
        dijkstra(s)
        if pi[t] == INF:
            break
        push(s, t)
        for h in range(m_):
            u = uu[h]
            v = vv[h]
            if pi[u] != INF and pi[v] != INF:
                cost_[h] += pi[u] - pi[v]
    c = 0
    for h in range(m_):
        c += cost[h] * cc[h << 1 ^ 1]
    return c

def main():
    global n_, m_, uu, vv, uv, cost, cost_, cc, aa, aa_, cnt, pq, iq
    n, m, k, c, d = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    ii = [int(x) - 1 for x in sys.stdin.readline().split()]
    aa = [L() for _ in range(N)]
    aa_ = [L() for _ in range(N_)]
    for _ in range(m):
        i, j = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
        i, j = i - 1, j - 1
        add(i, j)
        add(j, i)
    t = n + k + 1
    n_ = n * t + 1
    m_ = 0
    for i in range(n):
        for s in range(t - 1):
            u = i * t + s
            for l in aa[i].next:
                j = l.j
                v = j * t + s + 1
                for x in range(1, k + 1):
                    link(u, v, 1, c + (x * 2 - 1) * d)
    for i in range(n):
        for s in range(t - 1):
            u = i * t + s
            v = u + 1
            link(u, v, k, i == 0 and 0 or c)
    for h in range(k):
        link(n_ - 1, ii[h] * t, 1, 0)
    print(edmonds_karp(n_ - 1, 0 * t + t - 1))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    uu = [0] * (M_ + 1)
    vv = [0] * (M_ + 1)
    uv = [0] * (M_ + 1)
    cost = [0] * (M_ + 1)
    cost_ = [0] * (M_ + 1)
    cc = [0] * (2 * M_ + 1)
    aa = [L() for _ in range(N)]
    aa_ = [L() for _ in range(N_)]
    pq = [0] * (N_ + 1)
    iq = [0] * (N_ + 1)
    cnt = 0
    main()
